decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards like Counterspell, removal spells, and card draw to outvalue and outlast the opponent. Ephemerate is a key card that can provide additional value by flickering creatures like Augur of Bolas or Mulldrifter to generate card advantage. The deck also includes some graveyard recursion with Archaeomancer and Lórien Revealed, allowing for additional flexibility and resource utilization. The mana base consists of a mix of dual lands and snow-covered basics to support the spells and abilities of the deck.

The deck is focused on using a combination of control spells and Gates lands to outmaneuver and outlast opponents in a Pauper 1 vs 1 setting. It aims to quickly establish board control with cards like Prismatic Strands and Journey to Nowhere while also generating card advantage with Squadron Hawk and filtering through the deck with Brainstorm and Preordain. The Gates lands provide mana fixing and additional benefits with cards like Basilisk Gate and Citadel Gate. Overall, the deck seeks to control the game tempo and slowly grind out a victory against opposing decks.

The Gruul Aggro deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl to play big threats like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter early in the game. Using cards like Skred and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss to disrupt the opponent's mana base, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. With a mix of ramp, removal, and beatdown creatures, the Gruul Aggro deck is designed to apply pressure from the start and maintain board dominance throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. By using cards like Snuff Out, Counterspell, and Thought Scour, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage. Gurmag Angler serves as a powerful win condition, while cards like Tolarian Terror and Contaminated Aquifer help to fix mana and provide additional value. The inclusion of Fallaji Archaeologist and Lórien Revealed add versatility and flexibility to the deck, allowing for different lines of play depending on the situation.
